meta_title: Robin Hood Electrical | Electrician Nottingham & Sheffield
meta_description: Robin Hood Electrical: trusted electrician in Nottingham and Sheffield. Installation, repairs, and testing. Same-day service available. Call today.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, tripped electrics, or a full rewire? We arrive quickly, diagnose the problem, and get your power back on safely.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle every electrical job safely and on budget.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped switches, or dead sockets? We diagnose and repair faults fast, any time of day or night. Most jobs finished same day.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We replace outdated circuits and bring your electrics up to current Building Regs, with all work tested and certified.

services.title: New Electrical Installation
services.desc: Kitchen extensions, loft conversions, or new builds — we design and install circuits, consumer units, and sockets to spec and on time.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Certification
services.desc: Landlord safety checks, pre-sale inspections, or periodic testing — we issue NICEIC-backed certificates you can rely on.

services.title: Fault Finding & Diagnosis
services.desc: Intermittent faults, nuisance tripping, or mystery power loss? We track down the root cause and fix it without guesswork or bill padding.

services.title: Lighting & Specialist Work
services.desc: Bathroom extraction fans, outside lighting, EV charging points, or smart home wiring — we handle it all to current safety standards.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — no shortcuts, no cowboys.
about_para_1: Robin Hood Electrical was founded on a simple promise: honest work at fair prices. Based in Nottingham and serving Sheffield too, we've spent nearly two decades building trust with homeowners, landlords, and businesses across both cities. Every electrician on our team holds current NICEIC qualifications and carries full public liability insurance.
about_para_2: You'll find us turning up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and explaining what needs doing before we start. No upselling. No inflated estimates. We've built our reputation on repeat work and referrals because customers know we answer the phone, solve the problem, and leave the job clean.

reviews.text: Called them at half nine on a Saturday night with a burnt-out socket and no power in the kitchen. Dave was at the house by 11, found a dodgy terminal in the consumer unit, replaced it, and tested everything. Couldn't ask for a better response. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed a full rewire before selling. Got three quotes and Robin Hood's was competitive and honest. The lads worked cleanly, explained everything as they went, and finished bang on schedule. All certified and signed off. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had our landlord safety check done. The electrician was thorough, spent proper time on it, and gave us a clear report. No panic-selling extra work. I'd trust him with any of my rental properties.
reviews.author: James P.
